title: Injectivity Criteria for Upsilon Transforms
statement: Let $\gamma$ be a $\sigma$-finite Borel measure on $(0,\infty)$, let $\Upsilon_\gamma$ be the Upsilon transform on its Lévy domain, and define $\Upsilon_\gamma(\rho)(A)=\int_0^\infty\rho(Ax^{-1})\,\gamma(dx)$. Find general criteria on $\gamma$ under which $\Upsilon_\gamma$ is one-to-one on its Lévy domain.

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** partially solved

**Assessment.** General Upsilon-transform papers give domains, injectivity reductions, and several sufficient criteria, while also exhibiting non-injective examples. A complete criterion for every Levy measure gamma on its Levy domain remains open.
